Tratar prova de conceito e piloto como d: Treat the proof of concept and the pilot as separate decisions, each with its own success criteria: the pilot only starts if the proof of concept meets its criteria.
Acordar com o fornecedor que a prova de: Agree with the vendor that the proof of concept creates no obligation to run the pilot or to buy, and agree the price of each stage.
Começar por uma prova de conceito e, se: Start with a proof of concept and, if it meets the success criteria, run a pilot in a few schools.
Listar as ferramentas candidatas e as ta: List the candidate tools and the tasks of each before the test: the cost depends on how many there are and how they are paid for.
Exigir interoperabilidade entre as ferra: Require interoperability between the tools and apply a single data policy to all of them: access, retention, deletion and a ban on training models.
Verificar se as ferramentas cobrem as me: Check whether the tools cover the same tasks and avoid paying for overlapping licenses.
Pedir cotação por escrito das ferramenta: Request written quotes for paid tools with no price given: until then, the estimate uses an example price.
Levantar as escolas sem internet adequad: Identify the schools without adequate internet and budget for connection before the test: foundational conditions are often the first cost (Krueger and Jackson, {0}, p. {1}).
Orçar a conexão das escolas antes do tes: Budget for school connections before the test or choose a tool that works offline (Krueger and Jackson, {0}, p. {1}).
Escolher as escolas do piloto incluindo: Choose pilot schools that include some with weak internet, so the result also holds for them.
Orçar a compra dos dispositivos e planej: Budget for buying the devices and plan their replacement over the years of use: devices have a limited lifespan and need maintenance.
Levantar quantos dispositivos faltam em: Find out how many devices are missing in each school and include purchase and replacement in the budget.
Garantir acesso a quem não tem dispositi: Ensure access for those without their own device: relying on family-provided solutions can widen inequities (Krueger and Jackson, {0}, p. {1}).
Organizar a agenda de uso dos dispositiv: Schedule the use of shared devices and define who keeps them charged, updated and with separate accounts.
Definir quem paga a formação antes de co: Define who pays for training before contracting: otherwise it is often left out of the budget.
Incluir a formação no contrato, com hora: Include training in the contract, with defined hours per person, content, audience and format, and training for people who join later.
Formalizar com o parceiro o que a formaç: Formalize with the partner what the training covers and who maintains it when the support ends.
Formar também as equipes técnicas e de g: Also train the technical and management staff who will govern and sustain the AI, not only those who use it (Krueger and Jackson, {0}, p. {1} and p. {2}).
Incluir proteção de dados e uso responsá: Include data protection and responsible use in the training: the case processes student data.
Confirmar as horas de formação por pesso: Confirm the training hours per person with whoever will provide the training: the estimate uses an illustrative value.
Planejar formação contínua, e não única:: Plan ongoing rather than one-off training: tools change and staff turn over (Krueger and Jackson, {0}, p. {1}).
Fixar no contrato os níveis de serviço d: Set support service levels in the contract: hours, channels, response and resolution times, and what happens if they are not met.
Dividir por escrito o que o suporte do f: Divide in writing what vendor support and the education system’s support each handle, with response times for each.
Reservar o tempo da equipe que fará o su: Set aside the time of the staff who will provide dedicated support: the estimate counts these people as a cost, even if they already work for the education system.
Nomear quem faz o acompanhamento intensi: Name who carries out intensive use monitoring and set aside that team’s time in the budget.
Reforçar o acompanhamento do uso: com ri: Strengthen use monitoring: with elevated risk or decisions about students, light monitoring is not enough.
Contratar por etapas: começar a implanta: Contract in stages: start deployment with a group of schools, with criteria for moving forward, instead of the whole system at once.
Definir antes da implantação os critério: Before deployment, define the criteria for moving from the first stage to scale-up: use, results, cost per user and support.
Decidir a arquitetura antes de contratar: Decide on the architecture before contracting deployment: it changes who integrates, operates and pays for each part.
Exigir aviso prévio de mudanças do produ: Require advance notice of product changes and the right to export data and configurations at the end of the contract.
Definir quem integra e governa a aplicaç: Define who integrates and governs the application: with a model via API, this part falls to the education system or to a contracted integrator.
Vincular a expansão aos resultados da pr: Tie scale-up to the results of the first stage: reaching everyone in one year leaves little time to fix problems.
Prever e monitorar a cada ano o custo re: Budget for and monitor the recurring cost of scale-up every year: licenses, support and training grow with the number of users (Krueger and Jackson, {0}, p. {1}).
